title: SECURE MESH WIRELESS FALLBACK
description: A 2-part development toolkit covering secure WiFi fallback mesh configurations and hardware-level sleep optimizations.
content:
PART 1: SECURE MESH WIRELESS FALLBACK
Act as an expert embedded systems security engineer. Design a resilient FreeRTOS dual-core network connectivity routine for an {{Board Type|*ESP32-S3, ESP32-WROOM}}.

The system must satisfy these criteria:
1. Establish a primary connection to a local station router using WPA3 credentials. If connection time exceeds {{Timeout Seconds: 15}}, instantly spin up a local hidden Access Point (AP) mode with a dynamic captive portal.
2. Implement a safe hardware watchdog timer (WDT) on Core 0 that automatically triggers a full system reset if the main loop hangs for more than {{Watchdog Limit Sec: 8}} seconds.
